name: Biosaur2
description: Feature detection using the Biosaur2 algorithm for LC-MS data
code:
# Biosaur2
# Feature detection using the Biosaur2 algorithm for LC-MS data
algo = oms.Biosaur2Algorithm()
params = algo.getParameters()
# params.setValue("rt_window", 60.0)  # edit parameters here
algo.setParameters(params)
algo.setMSData(exp)
fm = oms.FeatureMap()
algo.run(fm)
feature_map = fm
print(f"Found {feature_map.size()} features")

name: Mass Trace Detection
description: Detect mass traces in LC-MS data (first step of metabolomics feature finding)
code:
# Mass Trace Detection
# Detect mass traces in LC-MS data
mtd = oms.MassTraceDetection()
params = mtd.getParameters()
# params.setValue("mass_error_ppm", 10.0)  # edit parameters here
mtd.setParameters(params)
mass_traces = []
mtd.run(exp, mass_traces, 0)

fm = oms.FeatureMap()
for trace in mass_traces:
    f = oms.Feature()
    f.setRT(trace.getCentroidRT())
    f.setMZ(trace.getCentroidMZ())
    f.setIntensity(trace.computePeakArea())
    f.getConvexHulls().append(trace.getConvexhull())
    fm.push_back(f)
feature_map = fm
print(f"Found {feature_map.size()} features from {len(mass_traces)} mass traces")

name: FeatureFinder Metabo
description: Metabolomics feature detection (mass traces + elution peaks + feature finding)
code:
# FeatureFinder Metabo
# Full metabolomics pipeline: mass traces -> elution peaks -> features
mtd = oms.MassTraceDetection()
mtd_params = mtd.getParameters()
# mtd_params.setValue("mass_error_ppm", 10.0)  # edit parameters here
mtd.setParameters(mtd_params)
mass_traces = []
mtd.run(exp, mass_traces, 0)
print(f"Mass traces: {len(mass_traces)}")

epd = oms.ElutionPeakDetection()
epd_params = epd.getParameters()
epd.setParameters(epd_params)
mass_traces_split = []
epd.detectPeaks(mass_traces, mass_traces_split)
print(f"Split traces: {len(mass_traces_split)}")

ffm = oms.FeatureFindingMetabo()
ffm_params = ffm.getParameters()
ffm.setParameters(ffm_params)
fm = oms.FeatureMap()
chromatograms = []
ffm.run(mass_traces_split, fm, chromatograms)
feature_map = fm
print(f"Found {feature_map.size()} features")

name: PeakPicker HiRes
description: High-resolution peak picking using wavelet-based approach
code:
# PeakPicker HiRes
# High-resolution peak picking using wavelet-based approach
pp = oms.PeakPickerHiRes()
params = pp.getParameters()
# params.setValue("signal_to_noise", 1.0)  # edit parameters here
pp.setParameters(params)
output = oms.MSExperiment()
pp.pickExperiment(exp, output, True)
exp = output
print(f"Peak picking complete: {exp.getNrSpectra()} spectra")

name: PeakPicker IM
description: Peak picking optimized for ion mobility data
code:
# PeakPicker IM
# Peak picking optimized for ion mobility data
# Methods: "Cluster", "ElutionProfiles", "Traces"
method = "Cluster"
pp = oms.PeakPickerIM()
pick_fn = {
    "Cluster": pp.pickIMCluster,
    "ElutionProfiles": pp.pickIMElutionProfiles,
    "Traces": pp.pickIMTraces,
}[method]
output = oms.MSExperiment()
for i in range(exp.getNrSpectra()):
    spec = exp.getSpectrum(i)
    try:
        pick_fn(spec)
    except Exception:
        pass
    output.addSpectrum(spec)
exp = output
print(f"Peak picking complete: {exp.getNrSpectra()} spectra")
